name: Moskvitin to the Pacific
summary: Thirty-one Cossacks from the new fort at Yakutsk go up the Aldan and Maya, cross the coastal range on foot and come down the Ulya to the Sea of Okhotsk: the first Russians to reach the Pacific, fifty-eight years after Yermak crossed the Urals.

stops.note: Thirty-one Cossacks set out from the fort on the Lena.
Up the Aldan and into the Maya by boat.
Down the Ulya to the sea. They build a winter camp: the first Russian post on the Pacific.
South along the coast by boat, where they hear of the Amur and its farming peoples.
Back with sables and the news of a southern sea.
